tagline: Unlocking the potential of biology for patients suffering from serious illnesses
hero_kpi_rationale: Amgen is a biopharmaceutical company focused on therapeutic innovation; its massive R&D investments are the primary driver of its future growth and pipeline of drugs in development.
company_description: Amgen Inc. discovers, develops, manufactures, and delivers human therapeutics worldwide. The company's principal products include Enbrel for the treatment of rheumatoid arthritis, plaque psoriasis, and psoriatic arthritis; Otezla for the treatment of adult patients with plaque psoriasis, psoriatic arthritis, and oral ulcers associated with Behçet's disease; Prolia to treat postmenopausal women with osteoporosis; XGEVA for skeletal-related events prevention; Repatha, which reduces the risks of myocardial infarction, stroke, and coronary revascularization; Nplate for the treatment of patients with immune thrombocytopenia; KYPROLIS to treat patients with relapsed or refractory multiple myeloma; Aranesp to treat a lower-than-normal number of red blood cells and anemia; EVENITY for the treatment of osteoporosis in postmenopausal for women; Vectibix to treat patients with wild-type RAS metastatic colorectal cancer; BLINCYTO for the treatment of patients with acute lymphoblastic leukemia; TEPEZZA to treat thyroid eye disease; and KRYSTEXXA for the treatment of chronic refractory gout. It also markets other products, including PROLIA, REPATHA, OTEZLA, ENBREL, EVENITY, XGEVA, TEPEZZA, BLINC

kpis.name: R&D Investment (% of Revenue)
kpis.explanation: Share of research and development expenses in revenue.
kpis.description: Amgen maintains a high R&D investment rate to fuel its pipeline of innovative drugs.
kpis.signal: High R&D level typical of biotech leaders

kpis.name: Gross Margin
kpis.explanation: Difference between revenue and cost of products sold, expressed as a percentage.
kpis.description: Amgen's gross margin is supported by the patented nature of its products and the absence of major generic competition on its key drugs.
kpis.signal: Very high gross margin, typical of patent-protected biotechs

kpis.name: Operating Margin
kpis.explanation: Operating profit divided by total revenue.
kpis.description: The operating margin reflects strong management discipline despite sustained innovation investments.
kpis.signal: High operating margin despite R&D costs

kpis.name: Capital Expenditures
kpis.explanation: Spending on physical assets such as plants or equipment.
kpis.description: Capex is rising to support the expansion of manufacturing sites and prepare for the volume ramp of new products.
kpis.signal: Rising capex to strengthen production capacity

kpis.name: Total Headcount
kpis.explanation: Total number of employees at the company.
kpis.description: Amgen is optimizing its headcount while maintaining a strong commitment to R&D and global markets.
kpis.signal: Slight headcount reduction despite R&D growth

kpis.name: Total Revenue
kpis.explanation: Total revenue Amgen generates by selling its drugs and healthcare products each year.

kpis.name: Repatha Revenue
kpis.explanation: Measures sales of the drug Repatha, which treats high cholesterol — a key commercial growth indicator.

kpis.name: Prolia Revenue
kpis.explanation: Measures sales of the drug Prolia, indicating whether this osteoporosis treatment generates growing revenue.

kpis.name: Tezspire Revenue
kpis.explanation: Measures sales of the drug Tezspire to assess its profitability and commercial success.

kpis.name: Free Cash Flow
kpis.explanation: Measures the cash generated by Amgen after capital expenditures, showing its ability to fund operations.

kpis.name: Total Debt
kpis.explanation: Measures Amgen's total debt. Useful for assessing financial risk and ability to repay obligations.

kpis.name: FY26 Revenue Guidance Mid
kpis.explanation: Forecast revenue Amgen expects to achieve in 2026, useful for assessing future growth.

kpis.name: Dividend per Share
kpis.description: Annual dividend per share paid, aggregated from yfinance.dividends over the last 7 reported fiscal years.
kpis.signal: Dividend per share of $2.52 in the latest year.

kpis.name: Capital Returned (Dividends)
kpis.description: Capital returned to shareholders via annual dividends, extracted from yfinance.cashflow over the last 4 reported fiscal years.
kpis.signal: Capital returned to shareholders via dividends of $5.124 billion in the latest year.

kpis.name: Payout Ratio
kpis.description: Payout Ratio = Dividends Paid / Net Income, calculated over the last 4 fiscal years from yfinance.cashflow and yfinance.income_stmt.
kpis.signal: Share of net income distributed as dividends: 66.5% in the latest year.
